summary: Q1 2026 earnings reported May 6, 2026: revenue $464.4M (vs $458.8M est), adj EPS $0.16 (vs $0.1593 est), 31% revenue growth, 8.3% same-shop sales growth, 41 new shops opened (1,177 total). Raised FY2026 guidance to $2.05B-$2.08B revenue and $370M-$380M adj EBITDA, now expecting 185+ new shops this year. Despite beat-and-raise, stock sold off ~4.8% after-market on classic 'buy the rumor, sell the news' dynamics following pre-earnings rally. DA Davidson raised PT to $75 from $70 (Buy).
